slot_notes.coverage: Semantic text slots map to existing editable bindings; footer and page number are excluded.
slot_notes.cardinality: Each slot accepts an array matching its exact listed source binding count.
slot_notes.style_profile: No semantic color role is exposed: remaining explicit fills are tied to layer/category/status semantics, opaque art, or backgrounds, so a safe single-purpose semantic role was not established.

style_notes: Source typography, geometry, theme, logos, and diagram meaning are retained.
No role-safe bounded color profile is declared; source fills carry category, status, background, or artwork meaning.
opaque_areas: Radial taxonomy wheel, sector geometry, and curved outer domain labels are graphical elements; only exposed text objects around/within the wheel are editable.
retained_source_content: Footer/legal line and slide number are source-bound.
Reference vendor/product names and source logos remain visible where present; examples are not represented as a clean client deliverable.
limitations: Fixed source geometry and binding cardinality; no dynamic reflow or variable item count.
Text fit is not measured; native PowerPoint fit and visual QA remain pending.
Illustrative planning copy coexists with disclosed original labels, logos, and diagrams; review retained source facts before client use.
